_doc: INSTALL-44 build lineage colours. Each long-lived line owns a fixed colour; a build carrying two or more non-trunk lines gets the nearest palette colour to their blend (cerulean + yellow = teal) until they merge. The palette is deliberately sparse so every name is distinct at a glance. A line colours a build only when the build carries at least carry_threshold of the line's own commits; below that it is listed in line_shares but the build keeps its trunk colour. Read by apps/engine_core/build_lineage.py.
